description:
Advances: specled.decisions

Severity: Medium. Two gaps in the lint shipped by specled_-vzd.6: (a) block chunking splits on blank lines, so inserting one blank line into a long comment block drops both halves under the 8-line threshold and the block escapes the pointer requirement entirely; nothing in the suite pins the intended behaviour. (b) the exemption marker accepts a one-character reason and is uncapped, so the reason-bearing requirement is satisfiable by noise — the abuse direction is untested.

Why not on the release branch: (a) needs a decision on whether blank-line-separated prose is one block or two, which changes what the corpus-pinned threshold means; the 8-line threshold was verified exact against the live corpus (8 red, 7 green) and would need re-verification.

Source: 2026-08-12 critical review testing M1 + M2.
title: Comment-pointer lint: one blank line defeats it, and the exemption reason is uncapped
